name: Turing.FinTM.idTM_computes
statement: theorem idTM_computes (x : List Bool) : idTM.ComputesInTime x x (x.length + 1)

name: Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM_computes
statement: theorem ifEqTM_computes (w₀ u v : List Bool) : (ifEqTM w₀ u v).ComputesFunInTime (fun w => if w = w₀ then u else v) (fun n => (w₀.length + max u.length v.length + 3) * (n + 1))

name: Turing.FinTM.condTM_computes_iff
statement: theorem condTM_computes_iff (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool) (hD : D.Computes fun x => [p x]) (x w : List Bool) : (∃ t, (condTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔ ∃ t, (cond (p x) M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t

name: Turing.FinTM.branchTM_spaceUsed
statement: theorem branchTM_spaceUsed (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t = if b then M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t + M₂.k else M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t + M₁.k

name: Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_computes
statement: theorem timedCondTM_computes {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool} {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀) (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1))

name: Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_spaceUsed
statement: theorem timedCondTM_spaceUsed (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ) (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T + (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2

name: Turing.pairDiagTM_computes
statement: theorem pairDiagTM_computes (x : List Bool) : pairDiagTM.ComputesInTime x (pairEncode x x) (4 * x.length + 5)

name: Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes
statement: theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

name: Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed
statement: theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.spaceUsed (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ 5 * (Nat.size x.length + 1)

name: Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_contracts
statement: theorem loopHostTM_contracts (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = out x s else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ), startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧ (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧ (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧ (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧ (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧ (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1), if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧ ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true]) else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1))

name: Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_decides
statement: theorem loopHostTM_decides (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : (loopHostTM body F anchor false).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))]) (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))

name: Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_finds
statement: theorem loopHostTM_finds (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = out x s else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : (loopHostTM body F anchor true).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => match (List.range (R x.length + 1)).find? (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) with | some i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) | none => []) (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))

name: Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget
statement: theorem loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧ (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = out x s else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.spaceUsed ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ 23 * (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k * (T x.length + 1)

name: Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM_computes
statement: theorem emitLoopTM_computes (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length, (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧ (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧ body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s)) with output := emitF x s }) : (emitLoopTM body F anchor).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))) (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))

name: Turing.FinTM.polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed
statement: theorem polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : (polyUnaryTM C e).tm.spaceUsed ((polyUnaryTM C e).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ 5 * e * (x.length + 1)

name: Turing.FinTM.unaryTokenTM_computes
statement: theorem unaryTokenTM_computes : unaryTokenTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2) (fun n => 3 * (n + 1))

name: Turing.FinTM.appendBitTM_computes
statement: theorem appendBitTM_computes (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) : (appendBitTM b).ComputesInTime x (x ++ [b]) (x.length + 1)
